title: Uniform finite geometric stalk cardinality bound for constructible abelian sheaves
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] and F an abelian sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Assume its underlying sheaf of sets is constructible in the finite-stratification sense [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. There is a natural number N such that, for every point x of X, the stalk of F at the point Spec of the algebraic closure of the residue field of x [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] is finite and has cardinality at most N. No curve, dimension, base field or torsion hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Definition 03RW and Lemma 095E; finite trivializing subcover and constant-value cardinality argument in step 1 of lem-weil-pbc-curve-constructible-annihilator; online sources https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03RW and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/095E

proof.text: Unpack the constructible stratification S. Each immersion is an embedding into the Noetherian space X; IsInducing.noetherianSpace makes its source Noetherian and hence compact. For each stratum use its locally constant trivializing etale cover. Choose its constant values and isomorphisms via Sheaf.mem_essImage_of_isConstant. These choices determine the values up to equivalence, and only their Nat.card is used. The images of the etale cover members are open by Scheme.Hom.isOpenMap and cover the stratum by Cover.exists_eq. IsCompact.elim_finite_subcover yields a finite set I of members.

The proved private definition constantChartPullbackIso transports the localized constant chart to the small etale site of its domain. The constructed set pullback and localization restriction are left adjoint to the same pushforward (sheafAdjunctionContinuous and mapPullbackAdj.sheafPushforwardContinuous), so Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq identifies them. Etale.overSheafEquiv and Etale.etaleToOverCompForgetIso identify localization restriction with transport from the localized site; Equivalence.constantSheafSheafCongrIso preserves the constant value. Apply the point fiber to this isomorphism, then Point.sheafFiberConstantSheafIso, and compare with the original stalk using etaleSetInverseImageStalkGerm. Nat.card_congr proves that every geometric stalk through a chart has Nat.card equal to that chart value.

Define the bound for a locally constant set sheaf on a compact scheme as I.sup of the Nat.card values. Any geometric point belongs to an image of one selected member. Scheme.exists_fac_of_etale_of_isSepClosed lifts it to that member. The preceding chart computation and Finset.le_sup bound its Nat.card. Empty members need not be discarded, since no point is lifted through them; even infinite constant values are harmless here, since finiteness is obtained separately from the given finite-stalk hypothesis.

Choose the bound N_i on each compact stratum and take Finset.univ.sup N. For x in X, the stratification covers x, so choose i containing it. Scheme.exists_comp_eq_of_mem_range lifts X.algClosurePoint x through its immersion; immersions are surjective on stalks. The stratum finite-stalk hypothesis gives Finite at this lifted point. etaleSetInverseImageStalkGerm transfers finiteness and Nat.card to the original set stalk. Its cardinal is bounded by N_i and then by the finite supremum. Point.sheafFiberCompIso for forget AddCommGrpCat transfers these assertions to the original abelian stalk. Supply the size-u filtered-colimit-preservation instance with preservesFilteredColimitsOfSize_shrink. The empty scheme is vacuous and empty finite suprema are zero.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03RW and 095E, finite trivializing-cover argument; fully implemented using the generic constant-sheaf, site-equivalence, inverse-image-stalk and forgetting comparisons. Finiteness is transferred separately, so no deletion of empty charts or choice of a point in every chart is required.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_stalk_cardinality_bound_of_constructible
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : IsConstructibleEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj F)) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ x : X,
      Finite (((pointSmallEtale (X.algClosurePoint x)).sheafFiber
        (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj F) ∧
      Nat.card (((pointSmallEtale (X.algClosurePoint x)).sheafFiber
        (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj F) ≤ N
